title: AeroTopo — 2308 Question Developer Simulation
subtitle: One interview question per lesson, with cumulative developer actions and the real AeroTopo project as the full-code reference.

books.title: Java Foundations & Enterprise Context
books.subtitle: Start with the Java platform, IntelliJ workflow, JDK, build tooling, and enterprise-development context.

chapters.title: 1: Java Foundations — Enterprise Context
chapters.subtitle: Java enterprise context, ecosystem evolution, IntelliJ/Maven setup, Spring Boot development environment, and core Java developer tooling.

chapters.title: 2: IntelliJ IDEA — Editor Choice & Keyboard Productivity
chapters.subtitle: Use IntelliJ as the project-standard Java IDE, understand why it fits the current project, and build fast navigation/refactoring habits with keyboard shortcuts.

chapters.title: 3: IDE Equivalents & JVM Foundations
chapters.subtitle: Translate familiar STS shortcut concepts into the IntelliJ-only workflow, then trace JDK/JVM selection, bytecode portability, JVM internals, and a complete Hello World execution path.

chapters.title: 4: JDK/JRE/JVM & Java Main Method
chapters.subtitle: Separate the JDK, runtime environment, and JVM responsibilities, then build and evolve a real main-method lab covering the entry-point signature, overloading, non-static failure, and the public/static launch contract.

chapters.title: 5: Main Dispatch, Type Casting & Static State
chapters.subtitle: Finish the Java main-method dispatch rules, then use the existing AeroTopo LanguageLab and JUnit tests to study type casting, shared static state, and Integer/String conversions without duplicating project code.

chapters.title: 6: References, Pointers, Nullability & Conversion Failures
chapters.subtitle: Contrast Java references with explicit pointers, prove primitive nullability rules, and distinguish ClassCastException, NumberFormatException, and null-unboxing failures with visible IntelliJ experiments.

chapters.title: 7: Runtime Type Checks, Parameter Passing & JVM Exit
chapters.subtitle: Use real AeroTopo language semantics and focused temporary demos to understand instanceof, Java pass-by-value behavior, System.exit, JVM shutdown, and when process termination belongs in project code.

chapters.title: 8: Project Methodology & Array Algorithms
chapters.subtitle: Ground the project-methodology answer in repository evidence, then reuse AeroTopo's real SurveyAlgorithms implementations for duplicate removal, merge-and-sort, binary partitioning, and stable zero compaction.
